word_bank.example: Their intense pressing forced the goalkeeper into a mistake that led to the opening goal.
Maccabi soaked up the pressure and then launched a devastating counter-attack to score.
The defender's close marking kept their dangerous striker completely quiet all evening.
The full-back made a brilliant overlap on the right flank and delivered a perfect cross.
The coach worked hard on set piece routines in training and they paid off with a goal today.
The winger ran past the full-back as if he was not there and whipped in a dangerous cross.
The playmaker pulled all the strings in midfield, creating three clear chances in the first half.
The match was still level after ninety minutes so the teams had to play extra time.
Although they lost the second leg two-one, their away goal from the first match sent them through.
The defender unluckily deflected the cross into his own net for an own goal.

stage_1_sentences.question: Hapoel Beer Sheva's high _____ in the second half forced Maccabi to make several mistakes at the back.
stage_1_sentences.hint_hebrew: כשהקבוצה מפעילה לחץ גבוה ויוצרת לחץ על הקבוצה היריבה

stage_1_sentences.question: Maccabi defended deep for an hour and then broke forward on a quick _____ to score the winner.
stage_1_sentences.hint_hebrew: כשהקבוצה מגינה ואז תוקפת במהירות לכיוון השני

stage_1_sentences.question: The coach ordered tight _____ on Hapoel's playmaker because he was controlling the entire game.
stage_1_sentences.hint_hebrew: כשמגן עוקב מקרוב אחרי שחקן מסוים כדי לנטרל אותו

stage_1_sentences.question: The left back made a superb _____ on the flank to support the attack and received the ball in acres of space.
stage_1_sentences.hint_hebrew: כשהמגן רץ מעבר לאגפן שלו לכיוון קדימה ויוצר מצב כפול

stage_1_sentences.question: The team spent all week practising their _____ routines and scored from a corner in the very first minute.
stage_1_sentences.hint_hebrew: מצב של כדור עצור, כמו בעיטת פינה או בעיטה חופשית

stage_1_sentences.question: The pacey _____ tormented the full-back all night with his speed and skill on the right flank.
stage_1_sentences.hint_hebrew: השחקן שמשחק על הצד ומנסה לעבור את המגן ולהכניס כדורים

stage_1_sentences.question: Their creative _____ orchestrated the whole attack, finding space between the lines and threading brilliant passes.
stage_1_sentences.hint_hebrew: השחקן היצירתי שמנהל ומארגן את ההתקפה

stage_1_sentences.question: The match remained level after ninety minutes and the referee signalled the start of _____.
stage_1_sentences.hint_hebrew: זמן נוסף שמשחקים כשהמשחק מסתיים בתיקו

stage_1_sentences.question: Maccabi drew nil-nil in the second leg, but their _____ from the first match was enough to send them through.
stage_1_sentences.hint_hebrew: שער שנכנס במגרש הקבוצה היריבה שנחשב יותר חשוב בהדחות

stage_1_sentences.question: The poor defender deflected the cross into his own net for a cruel _____ that decided the match.
stage_1_sentences.hint_hebrew: שער שנכנס על ידי שחקן לשער שלו בטעות

stage_2_story.text_en:
Moshe's son Avi is a big football fan who follows European competitions closely. One evening, Moshe and his grandson Yonatan sat with Avi to watch a thrilling European cup tie between Hapoel Beer Sheva and a strong side from Spain.

The Spanish team dominated the first half with intense pressing that left Hapoel's defenders no time to think. Their playmaker pulled the strings in midfield, finding the winger with clever passes again and again. Hapoel struggled to cope, and in the twenty-eighth minute, a well-worked set piece — a short corner routine — led to a goal that put the Spanish side one-nil ahead.

Avi explained to Moshe and Yonatan: 'Hapoel must stop the winger. They need tighter marking on him or he will destroy them all night.'

Hapoel's coach listened too. After half-time, he told his full-back to make overlapping runs on the right to stretch the Spanish defence, and told his players to look for a counter-attack whenever they won the ball. The tactic worked beautifully. In the sixty-fifth minute, Hapoel's full-back made a brilliant overlap, crossed the ball, and the striker was brought down in the box. Penalty — one-all.

The match stayed level deep into the second half. With only minutes left in extra time, the Spanish captain unfortunately deflected a Hapoel cross into his own net. An own goal gave Hapoel a famous two-one victory.

Hapoel had scored an away goal in the first leg and now won at home — they were through! Yonatan jumped off the sofa. Moshe laughed and said to Avi: 'I think I am starting to understand football.'

questions.question: Who did Hapoel Beer Sheva play against in the European cup tie?
What made Hapoel's defenders struggle in the first half?
options: (d) An early injury to their goalkeeper

questions.question: How did the Spanish team score their first goal?
options: (b) From a set piece — a short corner routine
(d) From an own goal by a Hapoel defender

questions.question: What did Avi tell Moshe and Yonatan Hapoel needed to do?
options: (d) Use tighter marking on the winger

questions.question: What tactic did Hapoel's coach introduce in the second half?
options: (a) More pressing and an extra striker
(b) Overlapping runs and looking for a counter-attack
(d) Long balls to bypass the midfield

questions.question: How did Hapoel earn their penalty?
options: (a) Their playmaker was tripped in the centre circle
(b) The winger was fouled near the corner flag
(c) The full-back was brought down after an overlap and cross
(d) The striker was pushed in the wall at a free kick

questions.question: How did Hapoel score their winning goal?
options: (a) Their playmaker scored from outside the area
(b) The Spanish captain scored an own goal
(c) Hapoel scored with a counter-attack in normal time
(d) The winger scored after a one-two with the striker

questions.question: When did Hapoel's winning goal go in?
options: (a) In the last minute of normal time
(c) With only minutes left in extra time
(d) In the opening seconds of the match

questions.question: Why did Hapoel go through to the next round?
options: (c) They won the second leg and had scored an away goal in the first

questions.question: What did Moshe say at the end of the match?
options: (a) He was too tired and went to bed
(b) He said he was starting to understand football
(c) He said football was still too complicated for him
(d) He asked Avi to switch to a different channel
